args.content:
import argparse
from logic import TaskLogic
from storage import TaskStorage

logic = TaskLogic()
storage = TaskStorage()

def main(args=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Task Manager CLI')
    parser.add_argument('command', choices=['create', 'get'], help='Command to execute')
    parser.add_argument('--title', help='Task title (required for create)')
    parser.add_argument('--description', help='Task description (required for create)')
    parser.add_argument('--id', type=int, help='Task ID (required for get)')
    args = parser.parse_args(args if args is not None else [])

    if args.command == 'create':
        if args.title and args.description:
            task = logic.create_task(args.title, args.description)
            storage.save_task(task)
            print(f'Task created: {task.title}')
        else:
            print('Error: Title and description are required for create command')
    elif args.command == 'get':
        if args.id:
            task = logic.get_task(args.id)
            print(f'Task ID: {task.id}, Title: {task.title}, Description: {task.description}, Completed: {task.completed}')
        else:
            print('Error: ID is required for get command')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
